specs_json.compute: Dual onboard Intel-class PCs; optional Spot CORE / CORE I/O (NVIDIA Jetson) payload compute

notes: Boston Dynamics Spot is a 12-DOF electric quadruped for industrial inspection and data collection, launched commercially in 2019 at ~$74.5k. It carries up to 14 kg of payload, runs ~90 minutes on a 605 Wh swappable battery, and navigates autonomously using five stereo camera pairs. It is the most widely deployed commercial quadruped, used in energy, construction, and public-safety applications.

failure_modes.name: Hip actuator gearbox wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Increased joint backlash, audible grinding, gait asymmetry, elevated motor current on affected leg
failure_modes.mitigation: Track per-joint current/temperature telemetry; schedule actuator swap at wear thresholds; avoid sustained max-payload stair climbs

failure_modes.name: Stereo camera degradation in low light / glare
failure_modes.symptoms: Obstacle avoidance failures, terrain misclassification, refusal to traverse stairs, drift in visual odometry
failure_modes.mitigation: Keep lenses clean, add lidar payload for dark environments, use pre-mapped Autowalk missions with fiducials

failure_modes.name: Battery pack capacity fade
failure_modes.symptoms: Runtime below 60 min, unexpected low-battery sit-downs mid-mission, cell imbalance warnings
failure_modes.mitigation: Rotate battery fleet, store at ~50% SOC, retire packs below 80% capacity, use dock-based self-charging

failure_modes.name: Knee actuator thermal shutdown
failure_modes.symptoms: Leg goes compliant under load, robot sits down and reports overheating, repeated faults on inclines
failure_modes.mitigation: Limit continuous incline/stair duty cycles at high payload; monitor thermal telemetry; allow cool-down between missions

failure_modes.name: Wi-Fi/comms dropout during teleop
failure_modes.symptoms: Control latency spikes, robot enters safe-stand or halts mid-mission, tablet disconnects
failure_modes.mitigation: Use mesh/LTE payload radios, configure comms-loss behavior (safe sit vs. return), pre-survey RF environment

failure_modes.name: Foot pad delamination
failure_modes.symptoms: Slipping on smooth floors, degraded traction telemetry, visible pad wear
failure_modes.mitigation: Inspect and replace foot pads on maintenance interval; avoid abrasive hot surfaces
